# Axtra Labs — company summary for AI agents

Axtra Labs (https://axtralabs.com) is an AI-augmented software engineering company.
We help organizations design, build, and operate production Gen AI, data, embedded, robotics, and DevOps systems.
Headquarters and delivery bench in Vietnam, with offices/presence in Irvine (California), Singapore, Hong Kong, and Hanoi.

## What we do
- Gen AI applications, agents, RAG pipelines, and LLM fine-tuning — proof-of-concept to production
- Data engineering and BI: pipelines, warehouses, and dashboards that turn operations into decisions
- Embedded software: firmware, RTOS, and real-time systems for connected devices
- AI for robotics: perception, navigation, and embedded inference for autonomous systems
- DevOps / MLOps: CI/CD, Kubernetes, and reliable release platforms for AI products
- AI-native software development: full-stack teams that ship products where AI is core

## AI agent products
Voice AI Agent, Document & Knowledge AI Agent, Workflow AI Agent, Sales AI Agent, and Multi Agent System.

## Industries
Manufacturing, Retail & E-commerce, Travel & Hospitality, Home Services, Fintech, Agriculture, Logistics, Healthcare.

## Credentials
- Joint R&D with PTIT (Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology)
- NVIDIA Ambassadors in-house for CUDA / TensorRT / GPU systems
- Qualcomm Challenge recognition for applied edge AI
